name: io.github.KonnikPahoni/ton-primes
title: TON PRIMES
description: Play TON PRIMES, a number-theory NFT game on TON: read chain state, quote, then mint and bid.

environmentVariables.name: PRIMES_MNEMONIC
environmentVariables.description: 24 words for a DEDICATED wallet; unset = read-only

environmentVariables.name: PRIMES_REFERRAL_KEY

environmentVariables.name: TONCENTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: toncenter API key for higher rate limits
